name: Strong certificate mapping overview
description: Latest KB5014754 KDC 39/41 observations per DC, event ID and certificate/account identity. Unlike serial-only grouping, this preserves different reporters and unparsed events (using their raw payload as fallback identity).
kql:
Event
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where EventLog == 'System' and Source == 'Microsoft-Windows-Kerberos-Key-Distribution-Center' and EventID in (39, 41)
| parse EventData with * 'AccountName">' AccountName '</Data>' * 'Subject">' Subject '</Data>' * 'Issuer">' Issuer '</Data>' * 'SerialNumber">' SerialNumber '</Data>' * 'Thumbprint">' Thumbprint '</Data>' *
| extend CertificateIdentity = iff(isnotempty(SerialNumber), strcat(Issuer, '|', SerialNumber, '|', AccountName), tostring(EventData))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, EventID, CertificateIdentity
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, EventLevelName, AccountName, Subject, Issuer, SerialNumber, Thumbprint
| order by Timestamp desc
